Text:
Nampaknya, PMX @anwaribrahim dan lebih-lebih lagi, Anthony Loke Siew Fook (@dapmalaysia) sudah "terlepas" cakap dipentas Konvensyen @pakatanharapan_ Johor terkait pembubaran Dewan Undangan Negeri (DUN).

Hari ini 4 Jun, masuk hari ketiga selepas DUN Johor dibubarkan yang berkuatkuasa 1hb Jun, 2026.

DUN Negeri Sembilan masih belum dapat dibubarkan. 

Nampaknya kemelut di Negeri Sembilan agak “complicated” dan tidak semudah ABC untuk proses pembubaran dibuat.

Pada 2 Jun, ADUN PH Negeri Sembilan mengadakan mesyuarat di kediaman rasmi Menteri Besar (MB) @dsaminuddin

Pagi 3 Jun, MB menghadap Yang di-Pertuan Besar Duli Yang Maha Mulia Tuanku Muhriz Ibni Almarhum Tuanku Munawir.

Pada sebelah petang, dilaporkan akan ada sidang media yang dipercayai berkaitan pembubaran DUN, namun ia dibatalkan kerana MB dikatakan mempunyai urusan yang lebih penting.

Jika kemelut di Negeri Sembilan tidak dapat diselesaikan segera, adakah ini bermakna DUN akan terus berjalan sehingga tamat tempoh, atau berdepan kemungkinan pembubaran awal atas nasihat MB, atau perubahan kerajaan sekiranya berlaku undi tidak percaya di Dewan Negeri?

Apapun, sebagai rakyat, kita hanya mampu menunggu dan melihat bagaimana perkembangan seterusnya akan berlaku.

I’ve previously pointed out that some UMNO leaders are highly strategic and cunning in politics. As speculation continues, they are increasingly being linked to the situation unfolding in Negeri Sembilan.

That said, I’ve always had my doubts about the PH–BN relationship. True enough, the political “conflict” between the two is evident — and it has arguably led Anwar and Anthony Loke to overreact at the recently concluded Pakatan Harapan Convention.

It appears that the “special treatment” extended by Anwar to UMNO in the Madani Government has not worked in PH’s favour. Instead, there is speculation that UMNO/BN are taking the opportunity to consolidate their position, possibly waiting for the right moment to make their move.

Ironically, Anwar/Madani appear to treat their own MPs differently, as seen in the cases of Subang MP @WongChen_MY and PJ MP @cheanchung, who reportedly lost access to the MyKhas system following differences in opinion and political stance. As a result, constituency allocations and People-Friendly Projects (PMR) have not been able to proceed as usual.

Itu menambah sebab mengapa aku akan tolak (tidak menyokong) PH (PKR-@KEADILAN, DAP & @PartiAmanah), @barisanasional (@umnoonline, @MCAHQ & @MIC_Malaysia) & PN (@PASPusat, @Bersatu_MY & @partigerakan) pada PRU16. 

Aku akan hanya keluar mengundi jika parti #Bersama meletak calon di #P117 Segambut. Jika tiada calon #Bersama, aku hanya boleh katakan 'sorry' kpd @hannahyeoh jika dia masih dicalonkan di P117. My slogan for GE16 is: No PH, No BN and No PN.

Text:
After DAP came to power in the 2008 general election, some serving party representatives were conferred honorary titles, which contradicted party policy.

According to DAP secretary-general Anthony Loke, he himself had been nominated for such a title but politely declined it.

Loke revealed that in 2018, Negeri Sembilan Menteri Besar Aminuddin Harun informed him that Yang di-Pertuan Besar of Negeri Sembilan Tuanku Muhriz Tuanku Munawir intended to bestow an honorary title upon him.

However, Loke politely turned down the offer before it was formally confirmed.
